fusions.name: Herd Wheel
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles of you is caught by a buffeting gust that deals 7 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 30%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Shooing Gust
fusions.desc: Drives a gust at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Lee of the Flock
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Barn-Warm Coat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
